description: A brand's customer personas: who it markets to, their age range and awareness stage, with the angles and offers aimed at each. Each persona is a segment nickname, the buyer's situation in their words, its share of the brand's ads, how many ads and landing pages speak to it, and its top angles and offers. Empty until the brand has enough ads and pages read. Use it to answer 'who is this brand selling to' or to compare two brands' audiences. Fields the user's Replo plan doesn't include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic); `lockedCount` is how many more results a higher plan shows. Say the data is on a higher plan; never estimate it yourself. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again.

companyRef.description: Company id or slug. Users call companies 'brands'.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_find_personas
title: Find a brand's personas
